xterm.js and xterm-addon-fit are vendored from the preinstalled Playwright trace viewer bundle, without modification. They provide the terminal emulator and terminal fitting logic. Source projects: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js and https://github.com/microsoft/playwright. This application does not load CDN resources.
